simple.meaning: זָנַח (zânach) is a Hebrew action word meaning “reject , forsake , fail.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 20 times in 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, Psalms, Isaiah, Lamentations, and 2 more, beginning at 1 Chronicles 28:9. The surrounding contexts include family, family line, altar, faith, kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זָנַח (H2186) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: זָנַח (zânach) / H2186 is traced through 1 Chronicles 28:9, 2 Chronicles 11:14, 2 Chronicles 29:19, Psalms 43:2 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H2186. zanach I. זָנַח verb reject, spurn (perhaps compare Assyrian zinû , be angry , especially of gods Gu § 105 Zim BP 23 ff. ) — Qal Perfect ׳ז Hosea 8:3 , 5 ; Lam 2:7 ; זָנַחְתָּ Psa 44:10 2 t.; suffix זְנַחְתָּ֑נִי 43:2 ; זְנַחְתָּנוּ 60:3 ; 60:12 ; 108:12 ; זְנַחְתִּים Zech 10:6 ; Imperfect יִזְנַח Psa 77:8 ; Lam 3:31 ; תִּזְנַח Psa 44:24 2 t.; — reject , Israel rejects good Hosea 8:3 ; Samaria's calf rejects her 8:5 (others make ׳י subject; We Kl. Proph. reads אזנת I reject ), elsewhere God rejects people Psa 43:2 ; 60:3 ; 77:8 ; 88:15 ; Zech 10:6 ; לָנֶצַח Psa 44:24 ; 74:1 ; לעולם Lam 3:31 ; ז בצבאתינו תצא ׳ולא Psa 44:10 ; 60:12 ; 108:12 ; מִשָּׁלוֺם נַפְשִׁי Lam 3:17 ; king Psa 89:39 ; altar Lam 2:7 . Hiph`il Perfect הִזְנִיחַ 2Chr 29:19 ; suffix הִזְנִיחָם 11:14 ; 3 plural הֶאֶזְנִיחוּ Isa 19:6 , see II. זנח ; Imperfect יַזְנִיחֲךָ 1Chr 28:9 ; — (late) reject (= earlier Qal ), Jeroboam rejects the Levites לי ׳מכהן 2Chr 11:14 ; Ahaz the sacred vessels 29:19 ; ׳י rejects Solomon 1Chr 28:9 . II. [ זָנַח ] stink, emit stench (compare Arabic become rancid , of oil, etc., Lane); — only Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine plural נְהָרוֺת הֶאֶזְנִיחוּ rivers stink Isa 19:6 (read הִזְנִיחוּ Ges § 53 , 6 Ol § 255 b Sta § 420 a Kö i. 293 ; but Ew § 123 b De Di derive from elative אַזְנָח or אֶזְנָח ).

occurrences.englishText: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for Yahweh searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.
For the Levites left their pasture lands and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office to Yahweh.
Moreover have we prepared and sanctified all the vessels which king Ahaz threw away in his reign, when he was unfaithful. Behold, they are before Yahweh’s altar.”
For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me?
You make us turn back from the adversary.
Why do you hide your face,
You have shown your people hard things.
Through God we will do valiantly,
God, why have you rejected us forever?
Has his loving kindness vanished forever?
I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up.
You have renounced the covenant of your servant.
Give us help against the enemy,
The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.
The Lord has cast off his altar.
You have removed my soul far away from peace.
For the Lord will not cast off forever.
Israel has cast off that which is good.
Let Samaria throw out his calf idol!
